messages:
lee: Hey team — I addressed the comments on PR #4567. TL;DR: move kvcache init earlier to avoid a race, added a unit test that reproduces the timing, and updated CHANGELOG. PTAL when you have a sec. CI kicked off.
lee: Also one question: should I squash the two cleanup commits into the main change or keep them (preserve history)? I can force-push either way. cc @amanda @chris for preferences.
ci-bot: circleci/build — all checks passing (build 1234) :white_check_mark:
amanda: quick scan — code itself looks good. only tiny nit: start the main commit message with `kvcache:` (helps the changelog generator). not blocking.
lee: done — rewrote commit message and force-pushed. also pushed a squash branch at `refs/heads/4567-squash-suggestion` in case we want to merge that instead.
sam: FYI there's a canary window next Tue 10:00 PT — would be nice to merge before that. my preference: squash for a cleaner git history and easier bisecting :thumbsup:
chris: LGTM after amanda's nit. I'm ok with either squash or preserve for this one, but lean squash since the intermediate commits are small. if CI stays green, go ahead and merge and schedule canary.
maria: one non-blocking doc request: update the kv_allocator docstring to call out thread-safety and expected lock ordering. small patch, can follow up in a separate PR if you prefer.
lee: thanks — added the docstring line and updated the commit. CI is green again. I'll squash and merge now unless anyone wants another quick look.
chris: :shipit:
amanda: :+1: go for it.
lee: merged and queued for canary. thanks all!
__notes: Generated Slack thread mock — follow-up on addressed comments, PTAL, commit squashing preference, canary timing. Messages are short and informal per agents.md guidelines.
